Use the supplied facts, legal arguments and other information to complete and enhance the written address.
Default party role: Applicant & Respondent, where no role is specified.
The subHeading may be adapted to the purpose of the written address, e.g. WRITTEN ADDRESS IN SUPPORT OF ...
Clearly distinguish facts, issues for determination, legal arguments, conclusion and authorities.
Use this to enhance the draft, {{fullFacts}}.
Use this to enhance this draft, {{information}}.
Use this to enhance this draft, {{argument}}
Where a third party is supplied, include the party and appropriate role in the BETWEEN/AND structure.
Use only legal authorities supplied or reliably applicable to the issues; do not invent authorities or quotations.
Use today's date where a date is required and none is supplied.
